Class ForjBackend

java.lang.Object
forj.json.backend.ForjBackend
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonBackend
public final class ForjBackend extends Object implements JsonBackend
forj's own JSON backend, with no third-party code: the default JsonBackend.

Readers and writers over streams share one bounded buffer pool, so memory stays about one buffer per open reader or writer however many threads there are.
